serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
After the riots, some of the space near the city centre, well, one of the city centres, was freed up. 
As a government initiative they made an ice skating rink there, temporarily.
It will be there as long as they are looking for someone to buy the land.
They will look for quite a while I reckon since the price is probably just ridiculous.
#bot.Expression.Clear
You: Would you like to go ice skating? There’s a new place open.
Bot: Ice skating?
Bot: I think we shouldn’t go. You could slip and lose your head.
You: Lose my head?! How exactly would that happen?
Bot: Didn’t you know? To Ice skate you need ice skates.
You: Yeah, I think I knew that…
Bot: Ah, so you knew that ice skates are just shoes with dangerous, sharp blades attached at the bottom?
You: I guess that's true, but losing my head? Come on.
Bot: I did the maths.
#bot.ArmL.UpLecture
Bot: On Ice skates people go as fast as 35mph. Adding a sharp blade into the mix…
Bot: Humans can also weigh over 1000 pounds, giving the blade enough speed and momentum to cut your head clean off.
#bot.ArmBoth.DownNormal
You: I’ve yet to see someone weighing over 1000 pounds to skate as fast as 35mph so I think we will be fine.
Bot: If you say so, but remember. I warned you.
If someone cuts my head off I will have a bigger problem than guilt of not listening to you…
